_note: Deterministic roster-status exclusions per replay season, board-agnostic population (any player with a committed game before Y). Rule, sources and both error directions: draft_replay_2025.roster_status_exclusions. Consumed by draft/backtest/replay_seats.js (the engine replay's status-filtered DIAGNOSTIC arm) and comparable with the board-scoped lists inside replay_league_table_restated.json.
rule: excluded iff zero recorded games in every committed season Y..2025 AND (Y<2025, corroborated by at least one later zero-game season) OR (Y=2025, absent from or teamless on the committed 2026 live board); indeterminable status STAYS and is listed
population: players with >=1 recorded game in any committed season in [2021, Y-1]
